description: This file defines the EmailMarketing class for SuiteCRM, which manages email marketing campaigns, including data fields, retrieval, saving, and related utility functions.

classes.name: EmailMarketing
classes.description: Represents an email marketing campaign with methods for handling campaign data, validation, and related database operations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to process date and time fields before saving the campaign record.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a record and splits the date_start into date and time components.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the campaign name for summary views.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Creates a new list query for exporting campaign data.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for list views, including prospect list names and campaign links.

methods.name: isCampaignDetailView
methods.description: Checks if the current view is the Campaigns detail view based on request parameters.

methods.name: makeCampaignWizardEditLink
methods.description: Adds edit links to campaign data for the wizard interface.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates supported interfaces, such as ACL.

methods.name: get_all_prospect_lists
methods.description: Returns a SQL query to retrieve all prospect lists related to the campaign.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the campaign fields and returns a list of errors if any.
